items.text: The cleaner changes seem to have gone down really well for most players. Still a handful of issues that I am keeping an eye on but nothing fixed with this one. Instead, this update will focus mostly on skills, delivering a much requested feature for all skill trees: endless nodes in the form of Mastery skills. There's also a new Last Orders option for winding the store down at the end of the day, and a round of fixes from your reports.
Features

Mastery Skills: once every other skill in a tree is complete, two Mastery skills open at the end of it. They take any number of points, each point adding a little less than the last, so long-time players finally have somewhere to spend spare points indefinitely:
Survival: Hardened (max HP), Seasoned Scavenger (looting speed)
Service: Regulars (reputation from fair sales), Big Tipper (bonus batteries per sale)
Crafting: Master Craftsman (crafting time), Lucky Batch (double craft chance)
Management: Tireless Cleaners (cleaner speed), Hardy Crew (all staff max HP)
Homesteading: Master Gardener (crop growth), Abundance (extra produce chance)
Mastery skills have an animated aura in their tree's colour so you can’t miss them.

Last Orders: A secondary option ‘Last Orders’ has been added to the open/close switch. Calling ‘Last Orders’ will ring a bell alerting all customers currently in the shop you will be closing soon. No more customers will come during this time. Customers with items will head to the checkout immediately. Customers still browsing are given 30 minutes to pick an item or leave the store. Once all customers are served the store will automatically close.

notes.title: New skills have also been added

items.text: Blast Padding (Survival, take less explosion damage)
Scarecrow Reach (Homesteading, scarecrows protect a wider area).
Fast Fastening (Crafting, secure object speed).
Doctor Gib's "Premium Cuts" skill has been rebalanced. It was making every spin land on Legendary; it now roughly doubles your chance of a Legendary prize.
Crates with items inside are no longer used up by upgrades or crafting. Only empty crates count, so your goods are never destroyed.
Several existing skills can now take more than one point. Skills you've already unlocked keep exactly the same effect and count as rank 1:
Survival: Constitution, Better Medicine
Service: Lift With Your Legs, Public Relations, Miracle Worker
Crafting: Resourcefulness, Industrial Shredding, Fast Fastening
Management: Armed Guards, Wide-Angle Watch, Thick Skin
Homesteading: Deep Watering, Seed Saver
Upgrading Farm Essentials with stacked Slat Crates no longer breaks the stack or leaves the player stuck when picking it up. Crates are now always taken from the top of a stack (or rack).
Customers should no longer get stuck at the checkout after paying, blocking the queue and costing reputation.

Customers coming back to repay a debt no longer run off with the batteries, and no longer pay 0. If you walk away they follow you, and if they can't reach you the batteries are still added to your income.
Customers forgiven at the checkout should now always come back the next day to pay what they owe.
Customers no longer freeze or get permanently stuck panicking after being scared by zombies, including when a zombie breaks a door or wall near them.
"Quick Hands" now speeds up farming work instead of slowing it down.
"Buyer's Market" now lowers the price customers ask when selling to you instead of raising it.
Hulk Helper skills now apply even if you bought them before freeing the Hulk Helper.
The day summary no longer shows income lines of 0.
Corrected skill descriptions: Rapid Rummaging now shows its real bonus (100%) and the double craft chance skill now shows 25%.
Robin should no longer rubber band at the job board on the day he is unlocked.
Quite a large drop with this one so as always please report any bugs you find, new or old and I’ll try see to them as soon as I can.
Adam ❤️

The big cleaner clean-up is here! I’ve read all of your suggestions and frustrations and hopefully cooked up some satisfying changes here. I fully scrapped the old cleaner logic as it constantly felt like two steps forwards and one step back each update. Starting fresh allowed me to consider every suggestion with the new implementation. Cleaners now have an internal ‘hive-mind’ and will reserve available jobs on demand meaning multiple cleaners will not rush to the same body or item. That solved a lot of issues on its own.
Level 2 Cleaner staff can now restock items from the warehouse onto the shop floor. This can be toggled per staff member. An additional toggle can be decided for how urgent they should restock.

Level 5 Cleaner staff can now carry containers to pick up multiple items at once while organising. This can be toggled per staff member. Additionally, you can set how many baskets the cleaner should leave to ensure there is always enough for customers to use.
Cleaners can now be instructed on which area of the store they should work on: Everywhere, Outside, Shop Floor and Warehouse. The area chosen decides the items considered in their decision making.

When a Cleaner staff member is active, you can right-click the Crafting station and instruct cleaners to organise the items on top of it via “Clean-Up Station”. Without doing this they will leave the items assuming you wish to craft with them.
Cleaner staff will now attempt to throw items onto pallets or shelves that they cannot easily reach.
Items set as Not Available For Purchase will be prioritised for Warehouse placement.
Staff members and customers will now phase through the player character instead of bumping them out of the way.
Staff member and customer pathfinding has been simplified to prevent getting stuck on objects and world geometry.
Storage objects such as crates and barrels can now have items placed into them that lock into place like shelves. They have been given the same options as shelves and pallets for cleaner staff.
Shelves can now be explicitly set as Dedicated per Item types as well as per Item.

Shelves, pallets and storage objects can now be explicitly set as Open (any item can live on them) or Off-Limits meaning staff members will not consider them in their work. I have removed the automatic inference as it was a headache to maintain with the new configurations, and to be honest was incorrect a lot of the time.

Shelves, pallets and storage objects secured in the Warehouse now have “Keep in Warehouse” toggle in their configuration to specify if you do not want items placed on them to be moved onto the shop floor.
Security staff members will also attempt to throw bullets into turrets they cannot easily reach.

Scavenger staff can now specify items to ignore when scavenging. This does not increase the chance of finding other items and will cost a trip each time an item is skipped. The intention is to prevent getting items you no longer have any use for.
Placement previews will now be shown on shelves, pallets and storage objects when trying to place an item.
If a shelf, pallet or storage object has no room for an item a warning will show on the attempted placement rather than dropping the item on the floor.
Added 25 new potential staff appearances.
Added staff portraits to reflect what they look like.
Day summary battery gained/loss categories now correctly show more explicitly the reason rather than often defaulting to ‘Other’.
Loot boxes from scavenger missions, gifts, raid rewards and contract rewards will now return to the front of the store should they fall out of the world.
Carrots have been reduced in size to allow placement onto more shelf objects.
The Wasteland Chiller’s top shelf can now fit all alcoholic drink items.
Sold stacked items (ammo, good meat etc.) will no longer provide huge amounts of batteries when serviced by service workers with the price multiplier skill nodes active.

Some really big changes here so please let me know if you are experiencing some new or old issues with your store layouts. The final bug fix listed will drastically reduce the income at later stages of the game. This could affect the balancing a lot and may feel like some purchases are now far too expensive, but as many players say batteries eventually mean nothing this is hopefully a good thing. I will keep an eye on it.
Next I'd like to look into why items are not locking correctly to shelves once placed if that has not been resolved with this patch.
Adam

What a week for the game and series as a whole. It's great to see so much excitement for TWT2 but of course I do understand the concern from some players that the first game is getting abandoned, but that is simply not the case. I wish I’d made that clearer in the sequel announcement tbh but here we are. To cope with the increased development I’ve expanded the team for TWT2 and we won’t see the sequel until late 2027 at the earliest. With that said, let's look at today’s fixes:
Bug Fixes
Items on the Rooftop will no longer be grabbed by customers through the ceiling.
Items and pallets stored in the medical room will no longer spawn a floating item outside the store upon loading the game.
When a crop produces a double harvest the item provided will no longer stack if it is not stackable.

Fixed an issue causing harvested crops to seemingly duplicate after longer sessions. Note: I was unable to fully reproduce this on my end so another cause of this may still be in play. Please let me know if this bug occurs once again.
Fully harvested plants will no longer fully regrow sometimes.
Fixed an issue causing advertising an item to attract additional customers unable to afford the desired item.
Certain objects such as Rugs are now lit correctly again.
There are now diminishing returns on harvesting extra crops from the same grown plant.
Harvest crops held inside containers are now smaller to help with visibility when harvesting a lot.
Hemp items packed on pallets will now be much more compact.
Extra crop harvests will now visibly pop-in to avoid confusion when harvesting crops.
Seeds given from the Seed Saver skill will now stack within containers during harvesting.

My next focus on the game is a huge cleaner rework before I hunker down on the underground bunker content update planned for early 2027. If you have features you’d like to see from cleaners (and staff in general), aside from them just not working at all, let me know!
Adam

Hey guys, it’s been a hot minute since the last patch as September’s Rooftop Farming update grows closer and closer. That patch was intended to bring a couple of improvements and quality of life players have asked for for a while, but, I’ve decided to push them early.

All shelves can now be configured to set dedicated items on them for the Cleaners to follow. If this is not set, Cleaners will treat that shelf as usual and try to infer what should be on there based on current contents. The game will now keep track of ‘known items’ so as you interact with more items, those items will appear in the shelf configuration.

When hovering over a shelf you can now see what the Cleaners will infer to place on it based on its contents. This should hopefully give a bit more clarity on why certain items are placed where they are.

Cleaners will now take loose items from the Warehouse to shelves that are dedicated to that item. If you would like to store items in the Warehouse you can store them on a dedicated shelf in there, in a storage crate, on a pallet or on the Crafting Station.
Items fallen off a shelf but still near it will now be considered for Cleaners’ organisation.
Long grass foliage has been added around the map. This can be fully disabled in the Settings.
Faint outlines will now appear on nearby items or bodies to help players see them when on the ground, at night time, in the fog or in the new grass. This can be fully disabled in the Settings.
Carpets and rugs will no longer play collision audio when secured to the floor.
Fixed a physics issue that caused staff members to get stuck in the ground or ceiling near the job board.
Fixed an issue causing mobs to get permanently stuck when knocked off the navigable floor.
Fixed an issue causing Security staff from endlessly ping ponging when directed to refill turrets.
Fixed an issue causing the Hellraid Steam achievements from not unlocking. These should now retroactively unlock when you open the game if you have beaten the requirement.
The Keybindings settings tab will now be fully localized again.
Base player movement speed has been increased by 25%.
As not all of you are in the community Discord, I’d like to share a screenshot of progress from the upcoming Rooftop Farming update coming in September. It ain’t much but it’s honest work… 🧑‍🌾

items.text: I swear physics will be the death of me. Thank you all for continuing to give me vital feedback on the state of the new physics update in the game. As well as some needed physics fixes, I have added some requested accessibility features to the settings menu.
Reduce Flashing: Reduces light flashes within the game. This includes muzzle flashes when shooting, bullet impacts and crafting items.
Reduce Post-Processing: Reduces post-processing effects. This mostly reduces the Bloom effect that brightens lights.
Brightness/Gamma: A slider from 0.5x to 1.5x that increases/decreases the global game brightness.
Camera Shake: A slider from 0x to 1x that reduces the intensity of the camera shake when taking damage, shooting, combat etc. 0x will fully remove camera shaking.
Idle Camera Sway: Toggles default idle camera sway.

Colorblind Mode: Toggle color correction to help with conditions Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia. Enabling these will reveal another option to select the intensity of the correction. Note: This will only affect the game world and not the user interface due to engine rendering restrictions. As I do not have any of these conditions myself I have tried to research the implementation as best I could. If anybody finds them to not be useful for the specified condition please let me know.
Audio Balance: The master game audio can now be balanced between -1 (Left) and 1 (Right).
Mono Audio: The master game audio can now be set to Mono mode, playing all sounds through both left and right channels.
Fixed an issue causing some items to slide endlessly across surfaces. Worst offenders included flimsy wooden shelves and storage crates.
Fixed an issue causing items to sometimes fall through surfaces at lower frame rates after being dropped.

Fixed an issue causing items with multiple shelves (Dual Shelving Unit, Weapon Rack etc.) to not correctly restore locked physics for the shelved objects on them. You will need to reshelve those items for the physics to lock again.
Tinned Tuna, 9mm Ammo, 5.56mm Ammo, 7.62mm Ammo and Shotgun Shells will no longer clip when placed onto a shelf.
The base lighting flash when crafting has been reduced.

If you still have this issue or new issues introduced please let me know asap! I know some players have reported issues with their player sliding a lot, if anybody has this issue and can find a clear way to reproduce it please get in touch.
Adam

items.text: Thank you all for the feedback on the latest update. Controller support is always a tricky one as there are so many layers to what can go wrong, from input drivers, engine compatibility before even reaching the game itself. I believe for returning players the new update had wiped some previous keybindings (ESC key being the biggest offender for some). For this update I am going to fully wipe and reset all previous keybinding data for mouse, keyboard and controllers. This should fix the issue for everyone. Any changed keybinds will need to be redone, so apologies there!
Fixed an issue causing the keybindings menu to hide after being used the first time.

Added buttons for all currently connected controllers in the keybindings menu. These can be manually removed and assigned. This intends to help players diagnose why their input may not be being received correctly.

Extended the maximum number of connected controllers from 1 to 100. This should prevent other controllers from overriding your intended assigned controller. It will mean that all controllers will contribute input simultaneously, so removing controllers you are not using will fix this.

If you see any of these issues still around or new issues introduced please let me know asap! As mentioned before, input system updates can be tricky due to the variations of every player’s setup, so if this update makes the experience worse, please let me know in detail and I will try to fix things as fast as I can.
Adam

Before we get into the patch notes I’d just like to thank everybody who bought the game, created content for the world to enjoy, kept Robin safe, reviewed and gave such critical feedback and suggestions! Most have been so kind and supportive, despite the major bugs early on. Hey guys, I know a lot of players have wanted some much needed quality of life and that's exactly what this week’s update is delivering. Staff have definitely taken the biggest focus with new perks, quick reassignment and role configuration.
Staff members will now remember their last assigned job. At the start of the day you can reassign it with one button by right-clicking them. This also persists between sessions.
Level 3 Service staff members can now empty containers with contents onto the floor before putting them back onto the basket stand. The intention is for cleaners to then organise the emptied items.
Level 5 Service staff members can now retrieve secured items for customers when not serving customers at the checkout.
Level 5 Security staff members can now refill Mountable Turrets and Auto Miniguns if there is no immediate threat to deal with.

Day Rewind: You can now rewind to a previous day's save directly from the main menu, with up to 10 days of history retained per save slot. Choosing to rewind and playing through that day will overwrite any future progress beyond that point. Hardcore saves cannot use this feature.

Added a new Carcass Balloon item that can be crafted using a Carnival Balloon, Large Bones and Rope. When released outside, the Carcass Balloon will fly away, luring away any revealed raid for an extra 30 days. This can be stacked indefinitely to effectively never encounter raids ever again.
Fixed an issue causing Cleaner staff getting permanently stuck holding an item they cannot path to place.
Fixed an issue causing the HUD notifications to overlap when too many notifications occur at once.
Customers will no longer accept price changes after picking their desired item.
Fixed an issue causing items to despawn overnight when taken from beyond the car park and left on the shop floor.
Players can now use containers to fill up Mountable Turrets and Auto Miniguns.
Players can now use containers to dismantle many items in the shredder.
Added configurable Scavenge job settings, allowing you to enable or disable auto-repeating scavenger tasks.
Added configurable Floor Worker job settings, allowing you to enable or disable item organisation, corpse disposal, and corpse shredding independently.
Added configurable Security job settings, allowing explicit Store room selection and the new turret refilling feature.
Added configurable Service job settings, allowing you to enable or disable serving customers, emptying containers, placing containers back and retrieving secure items.
Staff members will no longer charge batteries again when re-assigning a job of the same type (excludes World jobs).
Customers should now queue at multiple available checkouts more evenly.
The Skills button on the HUD will no longer say “New Upgrades” for a skill tree with fully unlocked nodes.
Improved the UI when highlighting a staff member to show their current HP and last or current job.
Security staff will now run back to their post rather than walking.

Ammo dropped via the new ammo slot will no longer despawn after saving and loading the game.

Minor world map changes in preparation for future content.

items.text: I’ve taken a little longer with this patch as I said I would now that we are moving into not just bug fixes but new features and quality of life. V1.0.14 is also the biggest in terms of bug fixes and improvements - so a massive thank you to all on Steam discussions and our community Discord for your really good feedback.
Features
Added an Ammo slot on the action bar to display all currently held ammo. With the ammo slot equipped, players can cycle through their ammo types and drop stacks of ammo.
Two stackable items can now be merged by holding one stack in Interact mode and clicking the other while it is highlighted.
Added a Raid Frequency setting to alter the pace in which new raids will occur.
Added an “Ignore by Cleaner staff” option in Item Details to specify if you want a particular item to be completely ignored by Cleaner staff.
4 Star Cleaners will now put corpses into the Shredder if it is operational.
Settings selected at the new saved game screen are now set from the beginning, not only from the in-game settings menu.
Mountable Turrets can now be grabbed in Interact mode after being detached in Build mode.
Moving Dual Shelving Units and Refrigerators in Build Mode will now bring all of their shelved items with them.
Fixed localization issues on naming ‘helper’ screen.
Fixed localization issue on day summary screen.
Containers should no longer be despawned if being carried by staff or customers when the player sleeps.
Currency depots on the Service Desk will no longer grow/shrink wildly out of control when being operated by Service staff.
Service workers should no longer give away batteries indefinitely.
Changing the price of items while a customer is requesting it from a Secure Shelf/Table will no longer be accepted by the customer.
Changing the price of items inside a customer’s basket will no longer be accepted by the customer.
Pallets will now show the true quantity of items packed accounting for stackable items, rather than item instance count.
Unsecured storage crates and shelving objects now have a yellow ‘warning’ tape around them to help ease confusion for newer players.
Removed the invisible floor above the Crafting Station in the Warehouse.
Cleaners will now prioritize placing items marked as ‘not available for purchase’ in the Warehouse unless there are others already on the shop floor.
Cleaners should no longer consider items inside Barrels or Storage crates as on the floor.
Improved general pathfinding to reduce the amount NPCs ‘repathing’ under tight spaces.
Shredding Sawblade Clubs and Chainsaws will now give the correct materials.
Customers should now give a positive reputation for Availability for each item they intend to purchase.
Declining a trade will no longer reward Service XP.

I’m really happy to see everyone is enjoying unlocking their hard-earned achievements. With those added it's been time to fix some of the bugs still ruining the player experience occasionally.

Fixed an issue causing customers to endlessly pick items from a pallet and drop them on the floor when browsing.
Fixed an issue preventing some corpses to not count towards the disposal skill bonus XP node.
The XP Gained notification should now react better when receiving lots of individual XP in quick succession.
The XP Gained notification should no longer stop showing after a longer play session.
XP gains will now be reflected more reliably when opening the Skill Trees.
Reduced the range and volume of the Hulk helper’s passive audio.

items.text: Thank you again for your support and suggestions! As a solo developer it’s so hard to build and play enough to encounter some of the issues you guys have been finding, so this continuous feedback has been so good. I’ve been fixing more bugs so here is another update.
Staff members should no longer attack each other when accidentally hit by a fellow staff member.
Staff members will no longer damage each other if they accidentally miss their target.
Staff and customers will no longer take damage or get trapped in Bear Traps.
The Hulk Helper will no longer take damage from Barbed Wire, Spiked Wall or Bear Trap defenses.
Fixed an issue causing workers to sometimes get stuck when asked to defeat a zombie horde or scavenge a location.
Unlocking world landmarks will now be more stable and less likely to lock. Re-opening the world map should unlock any landmarks that should already be.
Fixed Flimsy Wooden Shelves locking when being put in the Shredder.
Items won on Dr Gib’s game should not despawn overnight if left just outside the back door.
Moved the security store standing position to no longer block the open/close switch.
A lot of security staff improvements, I’m also taking suggestions on how to improve security role further. In the next patches I’ll be looking at cleaners, their behaviour is more complicated to fix.
Many have also asked about what’s next after the fixes so I’ll be doing a roadmap when things calm down and players are happy with 1.0!
Make sure you are on 1.0.5 for these changes (Sometimes a steam log out, log in is required to get update)
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3398110/The_Walking_Trade/"]
Thank you everybody for your support and suggestions! I’ve been fixing bugs non-stop so here is an update. Will be heading to sleep but keep the reports coming!
Defeated world map zombie hordes should now always open new locations.
Stackable items will now stack when purchased and delivered from World Map shops.
Workers and customers will no longer take damage from Barbed Wire or Spiked Walls.
Fixed an issue causing health to be capped at 100 when sleeping.
Fixed permanent max HP loss after using the blood station after sleeping.
Level 3 Service workers will no longer endlessly place incompatible containers on the sturdy basket stand.
Many of you have also been mentioning issues with Cleaners, Security and achievements.
I’m currently focusing on game breaking issues, with some quick easy fixes when I can.
Afterwards, I’ll be tackling these issues with the NPCs and consider some redesign/polish on how they work.

Achievements were something that didn’t make it for 1.0 and I published them on the store by mistake. The game doesn’t support achievements yet! Make sure you are on 1.0.4 for these changes (Sometimes a steam log out, log in is required to get update)
